seo_title: Wedding Photographers in Derbyshire | Zen Visuals, Belper
seo_description: Natural wedding photography by Zuzia and Ben, based in Belper. Whole-day coverage for £750, photos delivered within 3–6 weeks. Check your date.
hero_alt: Couple kissing in a shaft of light inside an old barn
intro: We're Zuzia and Ben, a husband-and-wife team based in Belper, photographing weddings across Derbyshire and the rest of the UK. Our photographs are natural and unposed, and true to how your day actually felt. Ben has worked as a photographer and videographer since 2014, and Zuzia joined him in 2023.
We stay for the whole day, so nothing is missed: getting ready, the ceremony, the portraits, the speeches and the dance floor.

sections.heading: One price for the whole day
sections.text: Wedding photography is £750 for your whole day, with no hourly packages. We stay for as long as you need us. Add a wedding film and both together are £1,650, saving £200.

sections.heading: Light, colour and real moments
sections.text: We look for the light first: shafts of sun in an old barn, golden hour under a gazebo, a quiet window while you get ready. Then we wait for the real moments to happen in it, rather than staging them.

sections.heading: Your photos in 3–6 weeks
sections.text: Your edited photographs are usually ready within 3 to 6 weeks of the wedding. We take half of the price upfront to secure your date, and the rest whenever suits you, up to two weeks after the wedding.

sections.heading: Where we photograph
sections.text: From our base in Belper we photograph weddings across Derbyshire, including Derby, Matlock, Ashbourne and the Peak District. We've worked at venues including Shottle Hall and West Mill in Darley Abbey, and in London a number of times.
